reasoning_traces.think:
The core causal structure hinges on estimating the average treatment effect (ATE) of going for it versus kicking on win probability. The primitive 'win_probability_delta' quantifies immediate outcome differences, while 'treatment_effect_estimand' aggregates these into total wins lost. Propensity score matching addresses selection bias by balancing pre-treatment variables. These primitives form a dual system where GSE evaluates strategic transitions and GSI computes posterior probabilities of strategic gains. Failure modes include model misspecification, unobserved confounders, and temporal inconsistency in win probability models. The framework assumes strategic decisions are binary and outcomes are measurable via win probability, which may not capture full complexity of coaching decisions.
